text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, July 7, 2019, Appeal DDRT-2019-17

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Confirmed the determination of a dangerous dog, that the conditions of the order remain in effect, and directed that the Tribunal forward the reasons for this decision to Rohan Manbahal and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before October 30, 2019.
